inspection_method: Each PNG was opened with view_image at original detail after the one approved D374 run.

observations.failure_provenance: The four failure cards are readable at original 1920x1080 resolution. Titles, body text, and the null/g0a footer do not overlap or clip.
observations.assembled_and_exploded: Both owner-local assembled subjects and both display-only exploded arrangements are visible. The labels explicitly prevent interpreting the exploded grids as a q5/world pose. The overview is context; the two part sheets provide detail.
observations.link5_16: A complete 4x4 sheet is visible: p000 through p015, one tile each. Role colors, callback polygon edges, names, and per-part millimetre bounds are readable without tile overlap.
observations.gripper_link_18: A complete 3x6 sheet is visible: p000 through p017, one tile each. Long names are intentionally ellipsized in a few titles, while IDs and dimensions remain readable and no title overlaps another tile.
observations.rerun_inspection: The fixed blueprint shows link5/gripper_link assembled views, link5/gripper_link exploded views, and the D374 event log. The upper-right startup notifications do not cover the gripper subject. The requested logical viewer window was 1920x1080, while the desktop DPR=2 capture is 3840x2160 physical pixels; exact presentation authority remains the four 1920x1080 boards.

scientific_authority: None. This is visual inspection evidence only; immutable callback JSON and hashes remain authoritative.
